findings.title: Reject unmanifested files and links on sealed snapshot verification and reuse
findings.consequence: An existing sealed snapshot can contain extra KB bytes, a blob whose availability entry remains missing, or an unlisted junction and still verify/reuse under its unchanged content-addressed ID. Consumers enumerating the frozen KB tree can observe unmanifested inputs or traverse outside the frozen tree. The actual private delivery has no extra entries; source-byte consumption through the extra junction by this module was not demonstrated.
findings.required_verification: Enforce the exact permitted sealed-tree names and metadata set without following links; reject unexpected files/reparse points and missing-entry blobs in published verification and reuse. Existing corrupt snapshots must not be overwritten. Add input/source extra-file, missing-blob and real junction/symlink controls, retain strict original native/hash/mutation tests, and rerun input suite, reviewer controls, project check, private copy/repeat audit and preservation against a new frozen delivery.
